name: Citadel
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://www.citadel.com/careers/open-opportunities/ on 2026-10-20 showed 'Viewing 10 of 63' (the 2026-10-19 capture also showed 'of 63'); all cards seen are in the sitemap
robots: ALLOW (no matching rule) for /career-sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml; robots.txt also has a group-less 'Crawl-delay: 10' that the RFC 9309 matcher ignores — honour it
notes: WordPress site (in-house 'gild' application form, no external ATS). Only the Yoast career sitemap is reachable over plain HTTP; listing, detail pages, admin-ajax, wp-json and /feed/ get a Cloudflare interactive challenge (do not evade). id = slug; title derived from slug (strip only the WordPress -2..-99 suffix, keep years like -2028); location = slug region hint; no posted date (lastmod is rewritten on every sync). The site's own Internships filter shows 28, equal to the slug-title regex. Full spec in discovery/notes/citadel.md; same checker as citadel-securities.
